cohort: The study included 170,002 Michigan Medicaid-enrolled individuals aged 15-44 who delivered a live infant between 2012 and 2021 and were continuously enrolled for nine months before delivery and up to three months postpartum.
finding: Medicaid-enrolled perinatal individuals in Michigan with OUD had higher rates of preterm birth and increased healthcare utilization compared to those without OUD.
mod_finding: Individuals with OUD had a lower probability of cesarean delivery.
